title: N.C.R.B., (M.H.A.) PRISON STATISTICS - 1999 Though highest Women Jails were reported in Andhra Pradesh and Tamil Nadu (2 each) followed by Bihar, Kerala, Orissa, Punjab, Rajasthan, Sikkim, Tripura, Uttar Pradesh and West Bengal (1 each), the total capacity of women inmates was highest in Tamil Nadu (612) followed by Andhra Pradesh (320), Rajasthan (200), Punjab (150), West Bengal (100) Uttar Pradesh (70), Kerala (64), Orissa (55) and Tripura (30).
